definitions.explanation: A dairy product made from churned cream, used in cooking and as a spread.

examples.japanese: パンにバターを{塗|ぬ}る。
フライパンにバターを{溶|と}かす。
examples.english: Melt butter in the frying pan.

examples.japanese: {無塩|むえん}バターでお{菓子|かし}を{作|つく}る。

notes:
バター is a loanword from English 'butter'.

COMMON TYPES:
- {有塩|ゆうえん}バター (salted butter)
- {無塩|むえん}バター (unsalted butter)
- {発酵|はっこう}バター (cultured butter)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- バターを{塗|ぬ}る (to spread butter)
- バターを{溶|と}かす (to melt butter)
- バターで{炒|いた}める (to sauté in butter)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- マーガリン (margarine)
- {乳製品|にゅうせいひん} (dairy products)
- クリーム (cream)

Japan imports most of its butter, and prices can be high. {発酵|はっこう}バター (cultured butter) is considered premium.
